inferences.status: derived from explicitly stated implementation steps
inferences.statement: O(m) sorting memory plus O(n·k^(k+1)) k-hop gathering memory gives O(m+n·k^(k+1)); k=O(1/ε). This does not give a uniform linear-in-input memory claim as ε changes.
At fixed ε,δ,λ≥2, exact formulas are grouped as n-constant, log log* n, (log log n)^3 or unspecified polylog(n). Forest λ=1 is separate. No parameter exponent is numerically chosen.
Lemma 1.4 and Lemma 4.1 explicitly establish expected quality; the terse Corollary 1.2 is read with that proof, not as a high-probability quality claim.

Model 1 states local S=Õ(n^δ), machine count M≥Ω(N/S), N≥n and aggregate M·S. A tight near-linear upper cap is not inferred from a lower-bound definition; Model 2 requiring at least n machines remains separate.

corrections: MPC Combinatorial Correlation Clustering factor is 2−1/8+ε, not the sequential/streaming 2−2/13+ε.
AKP2025 bounds per-machine messages, not internal memory; Remark 1.5 allows polynomial recovery space.
CHS2024 work Õ(ε^−7 m^(3/2)) and total memory Õ(ε^−3 m^(3/2)) differ.
Pruned Pivot and truncated Pivot have expected quality, not an automatically high-probability approximation.
C=O(1), α_best, O(λ²), unknown ε/δ exponents and unspecified polylog exponents remain symbolic.

related.statement: Lemma 4.7 obstructs a particular triangle-wise rounding analysis at factor below 2.4, not arbitrary CC algorithms.
